long_biography.plain_text:
Vasiliki Evangeliou sees Septona's supply chain as part of customer care. As vice-president, she supported a partnership with Famar to warehouse and distribute the company's products through Famar's Thebes centre. The agreement accompanied investment in manufacturing and staff, as Septona prepared to widen its personal-care range.

Her responsibilities also extend to the group's Bulgarian manufacturer, where she serves on the board. That business makes cotton buds, cleansing pads and wet wipes, alongside materials used in production. Its investment programme has included a new cotton-strip line to expand capacity and improve the manufacture of cleansing pads.
